name: Secura Dual Cestra
tradeable: unranked copies only, with no Forma or Catalyst installed

rows.label: Mastery Rank 10
rows.note: needed to buy it; standing can be earned before

rows.label: Pledge The Perrin Sequence
rows.note: equip its Sigil on the frame you play most

conditions: Pledging Perrin drains Arbiters of Hexis (-50%) and Steel Meridian (-100%). Spend any standing there first.
bonuses: Perrin standing gives New Loka +50%; Red Veil is neutral, so level it alongside.

groups.activity: earn standing from mission affinity and Syndicate Medallions
groups.mode: solo, hit the cap then run the alerts
conditions: Daily standing cap is 16,000 plus 500 per Mastery Rank, shared across every faction syndicate and reset at 0:00 UTC. 21,000 a day at MR 10.
Hit the cap with mission affinity first, then do the three Syndicate Alerts and turn in every medallion at the Perrin enclave in a Relay. Alert rewards and medallions bypass the cap.
Rank up as soon as you can afford it. Standing earned past a rank's maximum is wasted.
bonuses: Pledging converts 15% of all Affinity you earn into standing, so keep the Sigil on for everything.
Sanctuary Onslaught, Elite Sanctuary Onslaught and Duviri Circuit past stage 4 are the quickest ways to reach the cap.

disclosures.title: why 340,000
disclosures.body: 240,000 standing carries the five rank-ups to Partner, since each rank-up spends the standing it needs. The 100,000-standing weapon purchase comes on top of that.

rows.label: Aya
rows.note: 2 at Rank 4 Senior Executive, 3 at Rank 5 Partner

bonuses: Aya also drops from Void-related bounties and, rarely, Relic Packs; pick it up while standing accrues.

conditions: The free item you pick at the Partner rank-up can never be a Syndicate weapon; the Cestra is always a separate 100,000-standing purchase.
